details:
I feel that I should see if a world is compatible with my Quest 2 headset from the quick menu instead of just accepting my friend's invite only to be redirected to my home world or having to ask my friend if the world they're currently in is compatible for Quest 2 and awaiting their reply. A simple blue/green color indicator on the world invite in the quick menu would make it easier for me to see if it is compatible for Quest since I mostly play VRChat on my Quest 2.

--Edit 6 Sept 2022--
I made a thread similar to this but figured to merge it here.

I would also like to see a world history from a friend's profile so it can show what recent worlds my friend visited and if it's compatible for Quest 2, PC or both when the world is revealed instead of this whole "Friend is in a private world" thing. I get that this could bring some unwanted attention. I just don't wanna have to bother my friend when they're streaming VRChat on Twitch be like "Is this world compatible for Quest?" and await their reply or "What's the name of the world?" which would also request a reply from them so I can look it up on the website or on the Quest "Worlds" search bar.
title: PC/Quest compatibility world - Quick Menu
